dedupe_keys.name: medeas modelling the energy development under environmental and social constraints

description: MEDEAS (Modelling the Energy Development under Environmental and Social constraints) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by GEEDS group; University of Valladolid (http://www.eis.uva.es/energiasostenible/?lang=en). Coverage: Global; European Union; Bulgaria; Austria. Sectors: electricity, heat, liquid fuels, gas, solid fuels. Resolution: time Year, geography global, continents, nations. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
